check: Is the corridor drive-sim RF observation a deterministic function of pose (no RF noise realisation)?

inputs.consumed_z: why_ds_worse CONTROL trace R4_aB_m0_B0: z = nu + h + mu (OFF_BB)

method: noise-free first-path s from H (Hann window, 4x IFFT, 0.3 x strongest-branch threshold; same selector as ds_state_info_forensics.feature) matched by pose_id
conclusion: z_s is the noise-free deterministic feature of the pose channel. Residual autocorrelation in this corpus is pose (spatial/attitude) correlation sampled along the trajectory; there is no independent temporal RF component. observation.py supports adding complex Gaussian noise to H before the IFFT, but it was not active for these packets.
scope_limit: range component and other cases not rechecked here; same pipeline, expected identical
